## Scoped inputs and delivery

Read build contract, STATE/P02 checkpoint/contracts and relevant specification Section 3, F01/F26 and section 11 technical controls. P02 schema and pre-policy tests are available; carry its missing-runtime/PostgreSQL-version/official-type blocker unchanged. Used skill-router, Supabase/Postgres security guidance and ponytail; followed this numbered scope without agents/model switches or implementing P04.

- `supabase/migrations/20261024000200_authorization.sql`: current active membership and capability helpers derive auth.uid(), validate account/organization/term/membership/role/assignment/deployment status and dates, and pin empty search_path. Five authenticated-only SQL helpers: current_term_membership, owns_active_member, has_capability, read_directory, explain_access. Trusted owner bypass is required to avoid forced-RLS recursion; no caller-supplied actor or untrusted-metadata authority.
- Minimal column grants/RLS on all ten identity tables. Safe directory returns only eligible IDs/names. Own display name, affiliation and private-profile fields/sharing choices are writable; other identities, private rows, role/deployment/permission/grant changes, term membership expiry/status/org remain closed. Frozen terms read but block own writes. Guests cannot inherit core capabilities. Unit scope needs both explicit assignment and matching deployment. All changes are in one migration transaction.
- `supabase/tests/authorization.test.sql`: rolled-back fixtures for 11 subject identities including PM/head/equivalent MEAn/non-MEAn members/associate/guest/expired/suspended/nonmember/other organization. Tests explicitly assert authenticated is non-superuser/non-BYPASSRLS, exercise direct API-role SQL and check actual changed rows for allowed writes.
- `docs/permissions.md`: function signatures, safe projection, role/scope/expiry explanation, denied writes and infrastructure bypass contract. No impersonation or fictional success endpoint.
- Supporting path mappings: new `scripts/test-authorization.cjs`/package test:authorization; `identity-db.cjs` accepts an optional migration boundary so P02's zero-policy suite stays historical. Type generator now introspects five function signatures/defaults/table returns; regenerated database.types.ts. README/CONTRACTS/STATE describe the current boundary. No dependencies/UI/seed changed.

## Acceptance ledger

- **P03_A1 — passed in authenticated-role SQL; full-stack identity transport pending.** Domain-matching claimed email plus administrative metadata cannot help an unrostered subject. Nonmember, expired-but-active guest, suspended membership and suspended account see zero rows across all ten tables. Directory/capability/current-membership checks deny; other-organization context denies. These are synthetic session claims, not claims of real validated JWT/OAuth sessions.
- **P03_A2 — passed in SQL.** Equivalent grants produce identical capabilities/directory/unit results for MEAn/non-MEAn. Associate sees only its configured unit and has no other-unit/FIN capability; head cannot manage the other unit. Revoked/expired deployment, future/expired assignment, retired role and guest misuse of a core role do not confer capability. Own affiliation edit leaves authority intact.
- **P03_A3 — passed at API-role SQL boundary; actual HTTP/API check blocked.** PM/head/member/associate/guest cannot self-insert or change roles/scopes/expiry/permissions/membership status, linkage or organization. Raw member identity columns reject SELECT. Same-org and other-org private reads return zero; other-profile visibility/display edits affect zero rows. Own profile insert/update, display-name and affiliation edits assert row count, values and applicable actor/version stamps. Anonymous helper/private access fails; fixed search_path checked; frozen-term writes affect zero rows. No service-role-only proof or UI simulation.

No complete/live acceptance claim: actual PostgREST requests with locally issued authenticated-user JWTs, Supabase PostgreSQL 17 migration/seed/test execution and official CLI type comparison remain required. P02's blocker persists; no credentials/project link/deployment or provider configuration added.
